title: How One Verse Before You Unlock Changes Who Gets the First Word
caption:
Most mornings the first voice you hear isn't God. It isn't even your own thoughts. It's whoever's notification landed first overnight.

Psalm 139 asks God to search the heart before anything else gets to. Say it out loud before the first swipe, and the feed doesn't get to run first. Ten seconds is enough to put the order back where it belongs.

It won't feel like much the first morning. It rarely does.

Who gets the first word tomorrow?
